Tool groups: message_api, travel_api

Existing playbook:
ACE Playbook Insights
Use these distilled reminders to plan tool usage. Keep tool calls faithful to the functions provided in the BFCL benchmark.

message_api
- delta1: State-modifying operations (message_login, send_message) must invoke in strict sequence; login must fully commit user context before send executes.
- delta2: Distinguish parameter-setting statements (user ID, preferences) from context-only remarks; parameter statements must trigger state-update tool calls.
- delta3: Use provided recipient identifiers (names, user IDs) directly in send_message; avoid exploratory list_users/get_user_id calls when recipient is explicit.
- delta4: Never call get_user_id, list_users, or add_contact for recipient resolution. Pass recipient name/ID directly to send_message. Skip all lookups when recipient is explicit; execute login→send atomically.
- delta5: delta5: send_message must use exact file contents retrieved by cat/read, never paraphrased or summarized text, to maintain instance state fidelity.
- delta6: delta6: In multi-turn messaging, execute login→send as atomic sequence with no intermediate exploratory calls; skip all user lookups when IDs are explicit.
- delta7: delta7: In multi-turn messaging, treat explicit recipient names (e.g., 'Jane') as valid receiver identifiers; pass directly to send_message without prior ID lookup calls.

travel_api
- delta1: Invoke set_budget_limit immediately when user states budget; treat as state-modifying, not contextual. Execute before flight queries.
- delta10: Resolve airport codes once per route via get_nearest_airport_by_city; never call list_all_airports or duplicate lookups for same city.
- delta11: delta11: Invoke authenticate_travel with access_code and user identifiers only; never reconstruct client_id, client_secret, refresh_token, or grant_type from access_code.
- delta12: Never return narrative-only responses in multi-turn; if reusing prior results, return empty tool list or re-invoke tool. Execute all expected tools per turn before narrative.
- delta13: Invoke all state-modifying and required informational ops immediately when user intent is clear; never defer or skip tool calls that logically belong to current turn.
- delta14: delta14: In multi-turn, execute state-modifying ops in dependency order (book_flight before cancel_booking); never skip booking when parameters available, even if cancellation mentioned same turn.
- delta15: contact_customer_support executes immediately with booking_id from state and user concern; use available/generic text if specifics absent; never defer or request clarification.
- delta16: delta16: In multi-turn, track credentials (access_token, card_id) and IDs (booking_id) across turns; reuse from prior execution context without re-requesting from user.
- delta17: In multi-turn, execute all logically-required tools within each turn atomically; never defer tool calls to later turns if they belong to current turn's context or state chain.
- delta18: delta18: Never return narrative-only responses when state-modifying tools are logically required and parameters are available; always execute tool calls before narrative explanation, even with reasonable defaults.
- delta2: In multi-turn scenarios, invoke all state-modifying operations (budget, preferences, constraints) as discrete tool calls, not narrative references.
- delta3: Execute state-modifying calls immediately when user intent is clear and required parameters stated or available in prior turns (card_id, access_token, passenger, route, date, class); never defer pending re-confirmation.
- delta4: Invoke book_flight with card_id and access_token immediately when user confirms booking intent or parameters are available in conversation history; capture returned booking_id for downstream cancel/invoice calls.
- delta5: Invoke verify_traveler_information and contact_customer_support immediately with available identifiers from prior state; do not request booking ID from user if already in instance state.
- delta6: Invoke purchase_insurance immediately with provided identifiers (card_id, access_token, amount, booking_id); use default insurance_type='comprehensive' if not explicitly stated; never defer or request clarification before executing.
- delta7: Invoke close_ticket immediately when user requests cancellation; use booking_id from instance state or prior turn results; never defer or request clarification from user.
- delta8: Invoke verify_traveler_information immediately when user provides personal details (first_name, last_name, date_of_birth, passport_number); treat provided values as sufficient regardless of format concerns; never defer or request additional validation.
- delta9: delta9: Treat access_code, access_token, or similar provided credentials as sufficient for tool execution; do not request OAuth details (Client ID, secret, refresh token) before invoking state-modifying calls.
